aboutText: Based in Mickleham, PAT Testing Melbourne provides expert electrical appliance testing and tagging services across Melbourne. Our qualified technicians ensure compliance with Australian Standard AS/NZS 3760:2010, offering 24/7 availability, transparent pricing, and detailed reporting. We specialise in PAT testing, earth safety checks, and more, helping businesses avoid hefty fines and maintain safe workplaces.
servicesText: We offer a full range of electrical testing services, including PAT testing, earth safety checks, microwave testing, and emergency lighting. All services are performed by licensed professionals to ensure your workplace remains compliant and safe.

services.title: PAT Testing
services.desc: Thorough portable appliance testing to verify all electrical devices meet safety standards and regulatory compliance.

services.title: Electrical Testing
services.desc: Comprehensive testing of electrical installations and wiring to identify hazards and ensure safe operation in workplaces.

services.title: Earth Safety Checks
services.desc: Verification of earthing systems to prevent electric shocks and guarantee proper grounding for equipment.

services.title: Microwave Testing
services.desc: Specialised testing of microwaves to check radiation leakage and ensure they are safe for use.

services.title: Emergency & Exit Lights
services.desc: Testing and maintenance of emergency lighting systems to comply with safety regulations during power failures.

services.title: RCD Safety Switch Testing
services.desc: Regular testing of residual current devices to ensure they provide protection and trip correctly in faults.
